name: ioms/backend
description: Inventory & Order Management System - PHP native backend

scripts.low-stock: docker compose exec app php scripts/check-low-stock.php
sonar: [ -n "$SONAR_TOKEN" ] || { echo 'SONAR_TOKEN belum di-export (buat di SonarQube: My Account > Security).'; exit 1; }
docker compose -f docker-compose.sonar.yml run --rm scanner sonar-scanner -Dsonar.qualitygate.wait=true

scripts-descriptions.test: Jalankan seluruh suite PHPUnit (integration butuh MySQL)
scripts-descriptions.coverage: Unit + Integration + E2E dengan coverage (MySQL sementara di Docker)
scripts-descriptions.db:reset: Reset database dev ke schema.sql + seed.sql (opsi: -- --yes, -- --uploads)
scripts-descriptions.demo:api: Demo API-01: endpoint JSON tanpa auth (401), dengan auth (200), SKU tidak ada (404)
scripts-descriptions.demo:sod: Demo pemisahan tugas: Sales dan Warehouse mencoba approve SO lewat request manual (403)
scripts-descriptions.low-stock: Ringkasan produk di bawah reorder point (JOB-01, lewat docker compose exec)
